title: Line Follower Robot
tagline: An autonomous PID-controlled robot that follows a black line at speed.
description: Built using Arduino Uno, L298N motor driver, and an IR sensor array on a PVC chassis. Implements PID control for smooth line tracking.

title: Smart Irrigation System
tagline: IoT-powered plant watering system with soil moisture sensing and remote control.
description: ESP32-based system that reads soil moisture, controls a pump via relay, and reports data to a dashboard over Wi-Fi.

title: DIY Holographic Display
tagline: Persistence-of-vision LED cylinder creating 3D holographic-like visuals.
description: A spinning LED strip driven by an ESP32, synced via Hall sensor, rendering cylindrical volumetric images in mid-air.
